## Notes

Friday 16th Oct, 2026: 

This analysis aims to identify diferentially expressed genes between infiltrative and expansile CAF samples. The aligned RNAseq rawdata and sample metadata sheet used in this analysis are stored in: 

• '/Lab Shared/Nikita/RNAseq_STAR_aligned/merged_counts_renamed.txt'

• '/Lab Shared/Nikita/RNAseq_STAR_aligned/sampleinfo_master.xlsx'

## Data

Updated metadata sheet of all samples: 

```{r}
### Loading in the data 
###Loading in counts matrix
rawdata <- read.delim2('/Volumes/Lab Shared/Nikita/RNAseq_STAR_aligned/merged_counts_renamed.txt', header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

### Loading in sample metadata
sampleinfo <- read_excel('/Volumes/Lab Shared/Nikita/RNAseq_STAR_aligned/sampleinfo_master.xlsx')
create_dt(sampleinfo)
```

For the purpose of this analysis, we focus on only the CAF samples:

```{r}
sampleinfo_cafs <- sampleinfo %>%
  filter(Type=="CAF")

create_dt(sampleinfo_cafs)
```

A quick look at the rawdata for the corresponding CAF samples: 

```{r}
### subset rawdata to only CAFs
cols_of_interest <- c("ENSEMBL_GeneID","CAF55","CAF57","CAF58","CAF62","CAF63","CAF46","CAF65","CAF66","CAF67","CAF70","CAF76","CAF77","CAF78p3","CAF78p11","SCS15","SCS16")
rawdata <- rawdata[, colnames(rawdata) %in% cols_of_interest]
head(rawdata)
```

## Analysis

### Infiltrative VS Expansile 

```{r}
### Initialising DGE object 
y<- DGEList(counts=rawdata[-c(1:5),2:17], genes=rawdata[-c(1:5),1])

### matching rownames of sampleinfo to colnames of DGE object 
order <- rownames(y$samples)
rownames(sampleinfo_cafs) <- sampleinfo_cafs$`Sample-ID`
sampleinfo_cafs <- sampleinfo_cafs[order,]
colnames(y) <- sampleinfo_cafs$Label
```

#### Design Matrix

Factors to include in design:

• Sequencing batch (1,2,3)

• Growth pattern (INF,EXP,UNK)

• Tumour Type (Primary, Recurrence)

```{r}
batch <- as.factor(sampleinfo_cafs$Batch)
pattern <- as.factor(sampleinfo_cafs$Pattern)
type <- as.factor(sampleinfo_cafs$TUM_type)

design <- model.matrix(~0+ pattern + batch)

create_dt(design)
```

#### Filtering/Normalisation

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=30}
col <- brewer.pal(32, 'Paired')

genes_before_filtering <- y$genes$genes

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
lcpm <- as.data.frame(cpm(y, log=TRUE))
boxplot(lcpm, las=2, col=col, main="")
title(main="A. Example: Unnormalised data",ylab="Log-cpm")

### filtering/normalisation
### Calculatng normalisation factors

y <- calcNormFactors(y) 

### filter by cpm>10 in at least 2 samples
keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = pattern)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes=TRUE]

genes_after_filtering <- y$genes$genes

lcpm <- as.data.frame(cpm(y, log=TRUE))
boxplot(lcpm, col=col, main="")
title(main="B. Example: Normalised data",ylab="Log-cpm")
```

```{r}
paste("Number of genes BEFORE filtering =", length(genes_before_filtering))


paste("Number of genes AFTER filtering =", length(genes_after_filtering))
```

#### MDS plot {.tabset}

##### Growth pattern

```{r}
col.pattern <- brewer.pal(4, 'Pastel1')[pattern]
plotMDS(y, col=col.pattern)
title(main="A. Growth pattern")
legend("bottomleft",
       fill=c("#FBB4AE","#B3CDE3","#CCEBC5","#DECBE4"), 
       legend=levels(pattern))

plotMDS(y, col=col.pattern, pch=16)
legend("bottomleft",
       fill=c("#FBB4AE","#B3CDE3","#CCEBC5","#DECBE4"), 
       legend=levels(pattern))
```

##### Batch

```{r}
col.batch <- brewer.pal(5, 'Pastel1')[as.factor(batch)]
plotMDS(y, col=col.batch)
title(main="B. Batch")
legend("bottomleft",
       fill=c('#FBB4AE', '#B3CDE3'), 
       legend=levels(batch))

plotMDS(y, col=col.batch, pch=16)
title(main="B. Batch")
legend("bottomleft",
       fill=c('#FBB4AE', '#B3CDE3'), 
       legend=levels(batch))
```

##### Tumour type

```{r}
col.type <- brewer.pal(5, 'Pastel1')[type]
plotMDS(y, col=col.type)
title(main="C. Tumour Type")
legend("bottomleft",
       fill=c('#FBB4AE', '#B3CDE3', '#CCEBC5'), 
       legend=levels(type))

plotMDS(y, col=col.type, pch = 16)
title(main="C. Tumour Type")
legend("bottomleft",
       fill=c('#FBB4AE', '#B3CDE3', '#CCEBC5'), 
       legend=levels(type))
```
#### Differential Expression

##### DEGs

Top differentially expressed genes between INF and EXP samples using significance threshold of FDR < 0.05:

```{r}
### Estimate dispersion
### Fit data to GLM 
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)

### Making contrasts
infvsexp <- makeContrasts(patternINF-patternEXP, levels=design)
res <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast=infvsexp)
genes <- topTags(res, p.value=1, n=Inf)
DEgenes <- topTags(res, p.value=0.05, n=Inf)
dt <- as.data.frame(DEgenes)
create_dt(dt)
```

##### Volcano Plot

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=6}
EnhancedVolcano(genes$table, 
                lab=genes$table$genes,
                x = 'logFC',
                y = 'FDR',
                pCutoff = 0.05,
                ylim = c(0,2.5),
                boxedLabels = FALSE,
                drawConnectors = TRUE,
                max.overlaps = Inf,
                arrowheads = FALSE,
                maxoverlapsConnectors = Inf,
                labSize = 4) + ggtitle("DE genes between INF and EXP CAFs")

```

##### Heatmap

```{r}
samples_of_interest <- sampleinfo_cafs %>%
  filter(Pattern == "INF" | Pattern=="EXP")%>%
  select(`Label`)

y_subset <- y$counts %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(samples_of_interest$Label)

lcpm <- edgeR::cpm(y_subset, log = TRUE)
rownames(lcpm) <- y$genes$genes

### Setting up annotation data frame
type_annotation <- data.frame(Pattern = as.factor(sampleinfo_cafs$Pattern))
rownames(type_annotation) <- sampleinfo_cafs$Label

### Assigning colours for each annotation 
ColorCode  = list(Pattern=c( INF='#bfef45', EXP='#dcbeff'))

pheatmap(lcpm[DEgenes$table$genes,],
         border_color = 'NA',
         annotation_col = type_annotation,
         annotation_colors = ColorCode,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         cellheight = 50,
         cellwidth = 20,
         #main="Genes associated with platinum resistance ORG/TUM samples",
         fontsize = 15)

```
